content: I Bulus uti mi'dlǝl shilǝn ki atl dwaɗǝn i' usu, “Yelsǝni ini, bǝtl Lya kǝn amiɗa nǝ mbatl ki zoki hal i mbǝl cin ki sǝti ɗa.”
Ananiya bal lǝɓa ki Lya ul ginǝ ki dlǝli nja ma' Bulus su sǝ'op biwasi.
I Bulus ultisu, “Ki mul ngashtu, “Lya nǝn litiki, ase, ki dǝmni ki u ɓo zitǝn zhil kǝn ki ɗaya, ki ngu ɗǝ usu tǝ duni, gu shot nǝ zhil ki Musa
Ginǝ ki dlǝli nja nǝ Bulus su is usu, “Bal lǝɓa ki Lya kǝn ki byel twa?”
I Bulus ulsisu, “Yelse ini, amani ti bal lǝɓa ki Lya kǝn wai, Ki laciɗa: ‘Bǝ'dlǝm bezen lǝɓa tǝn mul kina ki mbalǝn wai.’ ”

Nǝ Bulus yeni, nami Sadukiyawa ni nǝ gen Palisiyawa u, itltlǝl yal age' lu domga i' usu “Yelsǝni ini, A mi' mul palisiyawani, yakǝn Palisiyawa. Tǝn a dlil mbadli i tǝn tlǝl lya ki mi' mǝshti i ami tleb bǝna ɗa.”
Nǝ' dlǝmi nǝgu u, i dlan nda ge' dlom ki palisiyawa nǝ sadukiyawa, i dob gani bwǝsi.
(Amma Sadukiyawa sa ndǝ nǝ hillya gǝ' ki mi'mǝshti twai, bǝ mi'shinkǝn ki Lya ɗawai, bǝ yal ki mbatl ki Lya ɗawai, amma mus palisiyawa is ndǝ' nǝ nali.)

I bal dla' hillya, gen ge' mi'lashti ki ɗalika ki palisiyawa is tlǝlyal asi shottibi. Asi ussu “Miɓo mambi mulu nǝ bezen ulǝn wai,” is ussu. “Ko yalkǝ mbatl ki Lya ko mulshinkǝn ki Lya kǝn shilǝn nǝti u pa?”
Nǝ shotti bi i ndǝndǝlu i mul kǝndǝdlom kum mɓulti ɓas kyakkyash Bulus. I' bǝlsi zhil tǝ mi' kǝndǝdlom susuɗi sǝ' kanti ɗǝ ma'si nǝ ndǝlti sǝ' tǝlati ge'lu dobga ki mi' kǝndǝdlom.
Nǝ gas pǝ u i mulban dlǝl nja Nǝ Bulus i' ultisu, “Ndǝl mbadli kan u nǝ'pǝl enti nǝ dwaɗǝn a tǝnkǝn a Ulshelima u, nǝgu ki' pǝl enti nǝ dwaɗǝn ini ɗaɗanu a Loma.”
Sa Kǝndǝ i sǝ' tlo Bulus
Nǝ lucilu i Yahudawa mabi is usu nǝ ndaltannaca sǝ' kǝn ɗamti nǝ tletiwai sai nǝ sa tlo Bulus.
Ginǝ kǝndǝ shilǝn u sǝ'ngǝtl mbalǝn kǝtl lǝbi upsi.
Is lǝ ma' bas lǝɓasi ki Lya nǝ mi'kina is usu, ma dlil bal tannaca i mǝkǝn ɗamtiwai nǝ tletiwai sai nǝ ma' tlo Bulus.
Gaki nǝgu kini nǝ mi'dlǝtl shilǝn dlǝmi mul'kina ki kǝndǝdlom sǝ' mbǝlli kinti, kǝnǝ ki' mbǝlǝn ngep gǝs ki shilǝn was tǝn kini iye mi kuma ki dlǝli tǝn asǝn kǝn mi'ɗa tǝn tloti nǝ mbǝtwasi.
Nǝ yakǝn ki yelse ki Bulus kumi nǝgu u i' suge' lukǝndǝ mbalǝnisi idlǝmi Bulus.
Iki Bulus taki bal mulkina ki kǝndǝ dlom gudǝl nǝm bi i' usu, “Kan yakǝn giɗǝnsi u ki tǝlati ma' mulkina; tinǝ shilǝn u nǝ tǝtl dlǝmi tu.”
I' kanti it tǝlati ma'mulkina, i' usu, “Bulus, ki lu ki kǝndǝn mbalǝn, shinǝni takami' yakǝn giɗǝsi u teɗi tǝn gaki ulki dlǝmi ni' ɗa.”
I mulkina ki kǝndǝ dlom goppi yakan giɗǝsi i' toh teɗi, amalgǝni in gyemti, “Yaki lyamti ki' dlǝmini?”
I usu: Yahudawa sa kǝndǝ i sǝ' gyemki ki mbǝlisi Bulus ma mi'dlǝl shilǝn akyau kǝnǝ sǝ' gyemti ki zokini tǝn shilǝnwasi.
Amma bǝ ndǝgisiwai, gaki mbalan ginǝ ngǝtl kutl lǝbi upsi siɓuttiti age' dǝlgǝn. Sa dlil bal ndaltannaca i sǝkǝn ɗamtiwai nǝ tletiwai sai nǝ sa tloti ɓutti sǝɗa katl ki ndǝgisi.”
I mul ki ndǝdlomi dǝlli' kǝmu i' za' yakǝngiɗǝnsi isi is zǝga nǝ: “Bǝ' dlǝmi mullǝn shilǝn u nǝ' dlǝmi uwai.”
Is pal Bulus tya Kaisaliya

I mulkina mbe bas mi' kǝndǝdlom was gudǝli lob bi i' ulsisu, “Gadlǝn mi' kǝndǝ dlom kutlt cen lob nǝ mi' kǝndǝ dlom mi'to'tǝn bǝtsi, kult lǝbi ninngi, nǝ mi' dlati nǝ zo kult cen lob sǝ'su Kaisaliya nǝ dom nǝtapsi ki gasi.
Ngayi Bulus bǝtsi tǝto' tǝnki asulǝnti ma' gobna ki Pelis.”
I mulkina ki mi' kǝndǝ dlom lash lwabati kǝnǝ nǝgu:
Te'ma' Kaldiwus Lisiyas, tu Ma'mulnalti, Gobna Pelis. Shilniti mul nalti.
Mulgu Yahudawa si lyam tloti, amma yalǝ nǝ mi' kǝndǝ dlommini yakwacati, a kumi timul dǝm ki pit a Loman kǝni.
Ami lyamti taman yakǝn laki singettiɗa, ya mbǝlti ma' mi'dlǝtl shilǝnwasǝn ɗa.
Yambi si dakǝtti tǝn shilǝn ki kushtiwasǝn, amma bezǝn lǝɓa u nǝs zitu atala ki kǝndǝti ko tlotwai.
“Nakumi sa kǝndi bezǝ' ulǝntintu, iki ya shini sǝ'talati maki. Ya ul mi' pǝtlti nǝ shilǝn ni su sǝ' dlǝm ulnǝ pǝli u akina wagi.
Tǝn gaki nǝgu imi' kǝndǝ dlom kan Bulus ne'si a gasi is talati Antipatlis.
Nǝ lucilu is za' mi'kǝndǝ dlom mi'tottǝn bǝtsi sǝ'zǝgane'ti, is paltya gelu dǝmtwasan.
Nǝ mi'kǝndǝ dlom mi'tottǝn bǝtsi mbǝci Kaisaliya u, is bǝl Gobna i lwabati is za' Bulus atoh wasi.
Nǝ gobna ya lwabatisi u, i' gyem Bulus kiɓo age'lu u kǝnkiɗa. Nǝ'kumi a Kilikiya u,
i' usu, “Anga'kiki kǝm ǝn mi' pǝtl ki nǝ shilǝn sa mbǝ u.” I gobna i bǝl zhil sǝ', dlǝl Bulus a bidla ki Hilidus.
